role: Canonical description of the training-load chain: per-workout load ladder, daily bucketing, Banister EWMA ATL/CTL/TSB, Load & Trajectory interpretation, the TrainingMetricsCache store, and where training load is and is not used.

units.does: Claims training load does not feed the recovery score (HRV + Sleep + Vitals only, ScoringWeights in Constants.swift); verified ScoringWeights.Tier3 0.60/0.25/0.15 (Constants.swift:399-402).

units.key: § Training Load — end-to-end calculation > The chain at a glance
units.does: Claims the chain: effectiveLoad ladder powerTSS ▸ [route estimate on strap dropout] ▸ hrTSS ▸ METs ▸ luciaTRIMP ▸ extrapolatedTRIMP else HR-only TRIMP; daily sum per local day with rest days 0; EWMA seeded at 0; live 180-day window; series 580-day replay keeping 400; ATL τ7, CTL τ42, TSB = CTL − ATL; today from TrainingMetricsCache.current; interpretation FormDescriptor/RampBand/TrajectoryVerdict. All matched in code (see later sections).

units.key: § Training Load — end-to-end calculation > Layer 0 — Per-workout load (the stress score of a single session)
units.does: Claims WorkoutSummary.effectiveLoad uses precomputedLoad when > 0 else calculateTrimp, then caps at TrainingConstants.TRIMP.maxSingleWorkoutLoad (1000, Constants.swift:338) via cappedLoad, logging when capped. Shown signature has defaults restingHR = 60, maxHR: Double? = nil.

flags.text: Quoted code shows `effectiveLoad(restingHR: Double = 60, maxHR: Double? = nil)`; the real signature is `effectiveLoad(restingHR: Double, maxHR: Double)` with no defaults and a non-optional maxHR, so the doc implies a 60 bpm resting default that does not exist.

units.key: § Training Load — end-to-end calculation > Layer 0 — Per-workout load (the stress score of a single session) > 0a. `precomputedLoad` — the preferred-source ladder
units.does: Claims for app-recorded workouts precomputedLoad = TrainingLoadPrecedence.stored with tiers power (storedPowerTSS, else readTimePowerTSS from NP and today's FTP for the sport, moving time), routeHistory when routeEstimateReplacesHRLoad, hr (hrTSS, LTHR fallback 0.88 × HRmax in WorkoutAnalyzer.computeHrTSS), mets (computedMETLoad, 12 METs anchor), banister (luciaTRIMP; Edwards fallback in WorkoutAnalyzer), routeHistory; same order as WorkoutMetadata.preferredTrainingLoad; runs off main; HealthKit workouts carry no precomputedLoad. Verified TrainingLoadPrecedence.swift:83-111, WorkoutMetadata.swift:659-666,709-721, WorkoutAnalyzer.swift:347-356, WorkoutMetadata.swift:627. The two ladders are separate copies (stored vs preferredTrainingLoad) kept in the same order.

flags.text: The doc's 'same order as WorkoutMetadata.preferredTrainingLoad' holds only by hand: the six-tier ladder is written twice (TrainingLoadPrecedence.stored feeds ATL/CTL, preferredTrainingLoad feeds the per-workout rows), with no shared definition, so a tier change in one makes the row's load differ from the load counted in CTL.

units.key: § Training Load — end-to-end calculation > Layer 0 — Per-workout load (the stress score of a single session) > 0b. HR-only Banister TRIMP (the fallback)
units.does: Claims HR-only Banister TRIMP: HRR clamped 0..1, TRIMP = minutes × HRR × A·e^(k·HRR), male 0.64/1.92, female 0.86/1.67 when biologicalSex == .female, constants in TrainingConstants.TRIMP (Constants.swift:318-327), no average HR → 0, restingHR = Apple resting HR else settings.effectiveRestingHR and maxHR = settings.effectiveMaxHR resolved once by trainingHeartRateAnchors and shared by live value and series. Verified HealthDataTypes.swift:369-391 (also returns 0 HRR when maxHR ≤ restingHR), TrainingHealthQueries+Queries.swift:488-495, TrainingLoadSeries.swift:20-22.

units.key: § Training Load — end-to-end calculation > Layer 1 — Daily bucket
units.does: Claims TrainingLoadSeries.dailyLoad pre-seeds every day with 0, adds effectiveLoad per startOfDay, skips workouts outside the window, clamps each day at maxDailyLoad 1200; workout set = archive + non-overlapping HealthKit (mergeArchiveAuthoritative, ≥60% of shorter), dedup scan up to 30 min, merge on same type within 5 min or ≥60% overlap, richness score precomputedLoad 8/avgHR 4/maxHR 2/calories 1; HealthKit workouts under 1 min dropped in summary(for:). Verified TrainingLoadSeries.swift:57-77, TrainingHealthQueries+Queries.swift:72-155,209-211, Constants.swift:339.

units.key: § Training Load — end-to-end calculation > Layer 2 — Banister EWMA → ATL / CTL / TSB
units.does: Claims Point.stepped uses exact decay e^(−1/7), e^(−1/42); point(through:in:) for live, replay for series; ACWR = ATL/CTL only when CTL > 0 (TrainingMetrics.acuteChronicRatio, TrainingMetrics.swift:30-33); live window 180 days (ewmaLookbackDays, TrainingHealthQueries+Queries.swift:630); series 400 + 180 warm-up (TrainingMetricsCache.swift:54,61); morning readings stop at yesterday but report todayTrimp, live includes today (TrainingHealthQueries+Queries.swift:505-520); Load & Trajectory takes today from TrainingMetricsCache.current; TrainingConstants.EWMA acuteDays 7 / chronicDays 42 (Constants.swift:343-346) — these constants are what stepped reads, not a mirror.

flags.text: Says the EWMA window constants are 'also mirrored' at TrainingConstants.EWMA (acuteDays 7, chronicDays 42), implying a second copy; they are the only copy and are what Point.stepped reads, so editing them changes ATL/CTL directly rather than a mirror.

units.key: § Training Load — end-to-end calculation > Layer 3 — Interpretation (Load & Trajectory surface)
units.does: Claims FormDescriptor thresholds >+10 Fresh, −5…+10 Held, −15…−5 Working, −25…−15 Tired, <−25 Very tired; ctlSlopePerWeek OLS over trailing 14 days ×7, 0 under 8 days; RampBand <−1.5 Easing down, −1.5…1.5 Holding steady, 1.5…3 Conservative, 3…8 Standard, >8 Rapid increase; compute order comeback → overreach → peaking → buildingBaseline unless >7 samples and week-ago CTL → delta = rampRate (fallback CTL difference when rampRate == 0) → TSB < −15 highStrain → delta > 1.5 building/rapidIncrease(>8) → delta < −1.5 detraining unless TSB < −5 maintaining → maintaining; peaking heuristic ATL < CTL by >10% over last 4 days; Foster monotony mean/SD over last 7 calendar days capped at 10, strain = week load × monotony, warning when monotony > 2.0 and strain > 1600. All verified in TrajectoryVerdict.swift:144-228 and FormDescriptor/RampBand inits, LoadTrajectoryLoader.swift:274-279, RecoveryScoreCalculator+Training.swift:24-45, FosterMonotonyWarning.swift:17-29, Constants+RecoveryScore.swift:230,237,244. TrainingDetailView uses the same isRaised rule (TrainingDetailView.swift:153-155).

flags.text: The doc names one peaking heuristic (LoadTrajectoryLoader.peakingHeuristic); the same 'ATL < CTL by >10% for the last 4 days' rule is implemented three times (Load & Trajectory loader, the Dashboard Load chip, the assistant trajectory fact), each a separate copy, so a threshold change in one leaves the chip, the screen and Flo disagreeing on Peaking.

units.key: § Training Load — end-to-end calculation > The store / source-of-truth
units.does: Claims TrainingMetricsCache (@MainActor singleton, TrainingMetricsCache.swift:19-21) holds current and a 400-day dailySeries; refresh fetches 580 days of HealthKit workouts once (TrainingMetricsCache.swift:373), resolves anchors once, rebuilds when the HistoricalKey changes; needsRebuild: no result or invalidated → always, LoadSettings changed → at once, archive workouts or day changed → after the 300 s burst throttle, else after 1800 s (unchangedMaxAgeSec); snapshot() uses the same rule; .flowRecoveryArchiveChanged invalidates only when the workout fingerprint changed; AI reaches it via TrainingLoadRegistry and training.load.* tools. Verified TrainingMetricsCache+Freshness.swift:12-69, TrainingMetricsCache.swift:98,142-148,283-320.

units.key: § Training Load — end-to-end calculation > Where it does and doesn't go
units.does: Claims training load is excluded from the recovery score (Tier3 0.60/0.25/0.15); ACWR above 1.3 applies a dampened readiness penalty (ReadinessScoring.applyACWRModifier, acwrOverreachingThreshold, ReadinessScoring.swift:257-266); Load & Trajectory and the Training Load screen show the same monotony warning; AI reads TrainingMetricsCache/TrainingLoadRegistry; reports read the live cache value (HolisticDailyReport.trainingLoadForReport uses the TrainingLoadRegistry.live() snapshot and falls back to the session's frozen trainingSnapshot when no live value was captured, HolisticDailyReport.swift:233-253).
